test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following did NOT ever preside over the Indian National Congress as a President?
solution:
The correct answer is **Dr B R Ambedkar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr B R Ambedkar** was a prominent leader and social reformer but never presided over the Indian National Congress.
 
• **Sarojini Naidu** was the first Indian woman to become the President of the Indian National Congress.
 
• **Surendranath Banerjee** was one of the early leaders of the Indian National Congress and served as its President.
 
• **Dada Bhai Naoroji** was one of the founding members of the Indian National Congress and served as its President multiple times.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1: Sarojini Naidu
 She was the President of the Indian National Congress in 1925.
 
 

 Option 2: Surendranath Banerjee
 He presided over the Indian National Congress sessions in 1895 and 1902.
 
 

 Option 3: Dr B R Ambedkar
 He was never a President of the Indian National Congress.
 
 

 Option 4: Dada Bhai Naoroji
 He served as the President of the Indian National Congress three times (1886, 1893, and 1906).
